## Key Information
- **Founder & Analyst**: Nikhil Gangil (IIT Madras Alumnus)
- **Email Contact**: info@intrinsicvalueequity.in
- **Office Location**: Baner, Pune, India
- **Registration Type**: SEBI Registered Individual Research Analyst

## Main Services & Tiers
- **HNI Premium**: 1-year research subscription tailored for portfolios of ₹10-15 Lakhs. Offers systematic cyclical sector rotation ideas.
- **Inner Circle**: Premium advisory tier with direct query resolution options and high-touch cyclical research advisory.

## Investment Philosophy
- Data-driven cyclical sector screening.
- Strict capital protection, downside risk management, and rigorous SEBI compliance.
- Focused on identifying major structural turnarounds and multi-year growth opportunities.
